text.body: oṃ mahīsutāya namaḥ | oṃ mahābhāgāya namaḥ | oṃ maṅgalāya namaḥ | oṃ maṅgalapradāya namaḥ | oṃ mahāvīrāya namaḥ | oṃ mahāśūrāya namaḥ | oṃ mahābalaparākramāya namaḥ | oṃ mahāraudrāya namaḥ | oṃ mahābhadrāya namaḥ | oṃ mānanīyāya namaḥ || 10|| oṃ dayākarāya namaḥ | oṃ mānadāya namaḥ | oṃ amarṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ krūrāya namaḥ | oṃ tāpapāpavivarjitāya namaḥ | oṃ supratīkāya namaḥ | oṃ sutāmrākṣāya namaḥ | oṃ subrahmaṇyāya namaḥ | oṃ sukhapradāya namaḥ | oṃ vakrastaṃbhādigamanāya namaḥ || 20|| oṃ vareṇyāya namaḥ | oṃ varadāya namaḥ | oṃ sukhine namaḥ | oṃ vīrabhadrāya namaḥ | oṃ virūpākṣāya namaḥ | oṃ vidūrasthāya namaḥ | oṃ vibhāvasave namaḥ | oṃ nakṣatracakra saṃcāriṇe namaḥ | oṃ nakṣatrarūpāya namaḥ | oṃ kṣātravarjitāya namaḥ || 30|| oṃ kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktāya namaḥ | oṃ vicakṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ akṣīṇaphaladāya namaḥ | oṃ cakṣurgocarāya namaḥ | oṃ śubhalakṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ vītarāgāya namaḥ | oṃ vītabhayāya namaḥ | oṃ vijvarāya namaḥ | oṃ viśvakāraṇāya namaḥ | oṃ nakṣatrarāśi saṃcārāya namaḥ || 40|| oṃ nānābhaya nikṛṃtanāya namaḥ | oṃ kamanīyāya namaḥ | oṃ dayāsārāya namaḥ | oṃ kanatkanakabhūṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ bhayaghnāya namaḥ | oṃ bhavyaphaladāya namaḥ | oṃ bhaktābhayavarapradāya namaḥ | oṃ śatruhaṃtre namaḥ | oṃ śamopetāya namaḥ | oṃ śaraṇāgata poṣakāya namaḥ || 50|| oṃ sāhasāya namaḥ | oṃ sadguṇādhyakṣāya namaḥ | oṃ sādhave namaḥ | oṃ samaradurjayāya namaḥ | oṃ duṣṭadūrāya namaḥ | oṃ śiṣṭapūjyāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvakaṣṭanivārakāya namaḥ | oṃ duśceṣṭāvārakāya namaḥ | oṃ duḥkhabhaṃjanāya namaḥ | oṃ durdharāya namaḥ || 60|| oṃ haraye namaḥ | oṃ dussvapnahaṃtre namaḥ | oṃ durdharṣāya namaḥ | oṃ duṣṭagarvavimocakāya namaḥ | oṃ bharadvājakulodbhavāya namaḥ | oṃ bhūsutāya namaḥ | oṃ bhavyabhūṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃraktāṃbarāya namaḥ | oṃraktavavuṣe namaḥ | oṃ bhaktapālanatatparāya namaḥ || 70|| oṃ caturbhujāya namaḥ | oṃ gadādhāriṇe namaḥ | oṃ meṣavāhanāya namaḥ | oṃ mitāśanāya namaḥ | oṃ śaktiśūladharāya namaḥ | oṃ śaktāya namaḥ | oṃ śastravidyāviśāradāya namaḥ | oṃ tārkikāya namaḥ | oṃ tāmasādhārāya namaḥ | oṃ tapasvine namaḥ || 80|| oṃ tāmralocanāya namaḥ | oṃ taptakāṃcanasaṃkāśāya namaḥ | oṃ raktakiṃjalkasannibhāya namaḥ | oṃ gotrādhidevatāya namaḥ | oṃ gomadhyacarāya namaḥ | oṃ guṇavibhūṣaṇāya namaḥ | oṃ asṛje namaḥ | oṃ aṅgārakāya namaḥ | oṃ avaṃtīdeśādhīśāya namaḥ | oṃ janārdanāya namaḥ || 90|| oṃ sūryayāmya pradeśasthāya namaḥ | oṃ yauvanāya namaḥ | oṃ yāmyadiṅmukhāya namaḥ | oṃ trikoṇamaṃḍalagatāya namaḥ | oṃ tridaśādhipasannutāya namaḥ | oṃ śucaye namaḥ | oṃ śucikarāya namaḥ | oṃ śūrāya namaḥ | oṃ śucivaśyāya namaḥ | oṃ śubhāvahāya namaḥ || 100|| oṃ meṣavṛścikarāśīśāya namaḥ | oṃ medhāvine namaḥ | oṃ mitabhāṣiṇe namaḥ | oṃ sukhapradāya namaḥ | oṃ surūpākṣāya namaḥ | oṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradāya namaḥ | oṃ śrīmate aṅgārakāya namaḥ | iti aṅgāraka aṣṭottara śatanāmāvalissamāptā ||
